findings.title: Include the Search source in cache identity.
findings.rationale: remember uses a module-global table, but Line 13 keys only by q. If two searchHandler instances use different Search functions, the second handler receives the first handler's result for the same query. Scope the cache to each handler or include a stable source namespace in the key.

findings.title: Use a bounded cache for query results.
findings.rationale:
remember retains every entry until process exit. q comes from the request and has unbounded cardinality, so distinct queries permanently grow the process-global table. A caller can drive memory growth until the process becomes unstable.

Remove this cache for arbitrary queries or use a bounded cache with eviction and expiry.

Safe baseline

-import { remember } from "./cache"; - -    // Repeated searches are common, so answer them from the table. -    const hits = await remember("q:" + q, () => search(q)); +    const hits = await search(q);
